history.recommendation_text: In paragraph 236 of its report, the Board recommended that the United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in Mali (MINUSMA), the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO), the African Union-United Nations Hybrid Operation in Darfur (UNAMID), the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL), the United Nations Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA), United Nations Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP), the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS) and the United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) establish and implement a standard operating procedure as prescribed under the weapons and ammunition policy.

history.sg_progress: MONUSCO is in the process of drafting a standard operating procedure on weapons and ammunition management in consultation with the relevant entities. In UNIFIL, an updated standard operating procedure on weapons and ammunition management is under final review by its advisory board on weapons and ammunition. In UNMISS, a comprehensive standard operating procedure on weapons and ammunition management is under development. UNISFA has drafted a standard operating procedure on weapons and ammunition management as prescribed in the weapons and ammunition policy.
